about: choice_diagnostic.py reports aggregated by summarise_choice.py (debug scale: tiny random backbone + debug core, LabWorld F1, schema-walker candidates, 16 decisions x 8 lifetimes per seed, world seeds 10000+100*seed+i; engineering diagnostic, not a scientific result). Arms: before_E = condition E on the snapshot of 6e83bcf (HEAD when LRN started; rule policy + INT2's value prior), seeds 0-2; after_E / after_D / after_E_mix0 = the LRN code of f8f3b5d with selection_rule thompson_policy, seeds 0-2 / 0-1 / 0-1; intermediate_v1_E = an earlier version of the LRN code (rule without the policy projection and without the model term); after_E_rule_policy = that earlier version with rule policy. Raw reports: choice_runs_20261127.tar.xz. Quality = truth(chosen) / max truth(C_t); expected_quality = sum_i p_i truth_i / max truth; greedy_pred_quality = truth(argmax q_goal) / max truth; policy_quality = the policy head's own softmax, same measure; intervals: bootstrap over lifetimes.
